description: Unilever Pakistan Foods Limited manufactures and sells consumer and commercial food products under the brand names Rafhan, Knorr, Hellmann's, Energile and Glaxose-D. Its range covers noodles, sauces, desserts and nutrition products, and a food-service division, Unilever Food Solutions, supplies professional products to commercial kitchens. The company reports that Knorr Noodles led its volume growth in 2025.
headOffice: Avari Plaza, Fatima Jinnah Road, Karachi 75530, Pakistan
